test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the formation of New States and Alteration of Areas, Boundaries or names of existing States ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 3 of the Indian Constitution **outlines the process for the formation of new States and the alteration of areas, boundaries, or names of existing States.
 
• In this regard, the **Parliament **may enact laws to:
 
 
• Form a new State by separation of territory from any State or by uniting two or more States or parts of States or by uniting any territory to a part of any State.
 
• Increase the area of any State.
 
• Diminish the area of any State.
 
• Alter the boundaries of any State.
 
• Alter the name of any State. 
 
 
 
• These provisions empower the Parliament to undertake significant changes in the territorial structure and nomenclature of States within the Indian Union.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 4 of the Constitution of India **enables changes to be made to the names of states in the Union of India and the allocation of seats each state receives in the Rajya Sabha. Additionally, it addresses incidental, supplemental, and consequential matters related to these changes.
 
• **Article 5 of the Constitution of India**, 1950, addresses citizenship at the commencement of the Constitution.
 
• **Article 6 of the Constitution **deals with the citizenship status of individuals who migrated from Pakistan to India during the partition between India and Pakistan.
